title: Space Invaders
summary: Three composed machines plus Frame's hierarchical-state-machine feature — pause() lives on the $InGame parent and Playing, PlayerDying, and WaveComplete all inherit it.
teaches: Hierarchical state machine · $Wave parent · inherited handlers via => $^
controls: A/D or ←/→ move · SPACE fire/restart · P pause

machines.title: Invaders — the orchestrator
machines.blurb: Top-level controller. Attract zeroes the score, then start advances into the $InGame parent which holds three children: Playing (the rally), PlayerDying (the brief stun after a hit), and WaveComplete (between waves). Because pause() is handled on the $InGame parent, every child inherits it — push$ stashes the current child and transitions to Paused, and resume pops back to whichever was active.

machines.title: Player
machines.blurb: The player's modes: Alive (steerable, can shoot), Exploding (the death animation), Invulnerable (a grace window after respawn so a stray bullet doesn't kill you on entry), and Dead (out of lives). The Invaders orchestrator routes hits and respawns; the Player machine decides what they mean.

machines.title: Fleet
machines.blurb: The alien formation. Marching is the steady horizontal sweep; Stepping is the brief downward shift at the edge before reversing direction; Defeated is the wave-cleared end state. Owns the alive/dead bitmap behind kill_invader(index).
